card.line: Shittim was Israel's camp in the plains of Moab, near the Jordan across from Jericho, where Israel sinned and later set out to enter the promised land.

moments.title: Israel worships Baal of Peor
moments.text: While Israel stayed at Shittim, the men fell into sexual sin with Moabite women and joined in worshiping Baal of Peor. The anger of the LORD burned against them.

moments.title: Joshua sends two spies
moments.text: Joshua secretly sent two spies from Shittim to inspect the land, especially Jericho. The men then went to Jericho.

moments.title: Leaving for the Jordan
moments.text: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites left Shittim and went to the Jordan. They camped there before crossing over.
